findings.issue: １日 meaning 'in one day / per day' is read いちにち, not ついたち (ついたち = 1st day of the month). Context 'how many hot dogs do you sell in a day' requires いちにち. Romaji 'tsuitachide...' needs the same fix (ichinichide...).
findings.current: ついたちでどれくらいほっとどっぐをうるんですか?
findings.suggested: いちにちでどれくらいほっとどっぐをうるんですか?

findings.issue: Token １日 glossed 'a day, per day' must be read いちにち in this duration/rate sense; ついたち is the calendar reading (1st of the month) and is wrong here.

Default readings of the numbers are wrong: １３ = じゅうさん and ３０ = さんじゅう. いちさん is a specialized digit-by-digit reading and さんれい is not a natural reading of 30 at all. Romaji 'ichisan...sanrei' needs the same fix.
findings.current: いちさんっていった?それともさんれい?
findings.suggested: じゅうさんっていった?それともさんじゅう?

findings.issue: １３ as a quantity is read じゅうさん; いちさん is a digit-by-digit spelling reading not appropriate as the taught reading here.
３０ is read さんじゅう. さんれい is not a valid/natural reading of 30 (even digit-wise it would be さんまる or さんゼロ).

Gloss of ない contains copy-paste contamination from another sentence: it references the regret pattern 〜んじゃなかった, which does not occur here. This sentence's construction is わけではない (as the token's own note correctly says).
findings.current: não ser / não dever (negação, aqui no arrependimento 〜んじゃなかった)
findings.suggested: não ser (negação, fechando わけではない: 'não é o caso')

findings.issue: en does not mirror the jp: けど is contrastive 'but' (the expl itself teaches this) yet en says 'and'; 'so hungry' adds an intensifier absent from jp; 'lunch' over-specifies ご飯 (meal/food). pt correctly uses 'mas'.
findings.current: I am so hungry and lunch is not ready.
findings.suggested: I'm hungry, but the food isn't ready.

findings.issue: Token list double-covers 何歳: null-glossed fragments 何 (tokens[0]) and 歳 (tokens[1]) coexist with the combined token 何歳 (tokens[2]), so concatenated surfaces no longer tile the sentence (何歳 appears twice). Keep only the combined token (or only the fragments).
findings.suggested: keep 何歳 as sole token; delete the null fragments 何 and 歳

findings.issue: English gloss 'to be able to walk' is wrong for 乗れる (to ride/get on); 'walk' leaked from the Portuguese idiom 'andar de bicicleta'. The pt gloss is fine; the en should only say 'ride'.
親 means parent, not specifically father; the natural en ('Those who are parents') and the token gloss ('parent(s)') say so, but lit_en narrows to 'father'.
findings.current: One who is a father should raise his children firmly.
findings.suggested: One who is a parent should raise their children firmly.

findings.issue: Same narrowing as lit_en: 親 = pai/mãe (the natural pt says 'Quem é pai ou mãe'), but lit_pt renders it only as 'pai'.
findings.current: Aquele que é pai, quanto aos filhos, deve criá-los firmemente é.
findings.suggested: Aquele que é pai/mãe, quanto aos filhos, deve criá-los firmemente é.
